notes: Awarded each time the Damage Ranking is reset. Each pack contains 1 of the following cards:

The Card Trader EX appeared during this event and remained open until one week after its conclusion. The player can trade their EX Jewels for cards, Booster Items, Gold, and Skill Chips. Each card, Skill Chip and Booster Item can only be obtained once from the Card Trader EX during this event, but Gold can be obtained any number of times.

The following missions were added on December 11, 2021 (during the first run) or February 19, 2022 (during the second run). Each mission does not appear if the player already has that reward from the previous run.
